topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I heard tell of a neighbor who crafted a new way to mend the walls of our barns, stronger and with less wood. Proud he was, showing it off to all, hoping to sell his skill. But now comes word from the town that another, far away, has already laid claim to it. A paper from the king's own scribes, they say. The poor man, he walks the fields now, gaze lowered, as if searching for something lost. I pray to Saint Benedict, the patron of peasants, for his guidance and the strength to find a new path. For in this world, it seems, even our simplest deeds are bound by the hands of others.
